summary: Iter142 verification — Double-sided Referral (#37), 6-month Compounds Trend Chart (#36), and Dark Mode toggle (#40). 8/8 backend pytest cases PASS. Frontend: ThemeToggle (homepage) works (toggle reversible, dark class + body bg switch, localStorage persists across reload). Compounds Trend Chart renders inside Company Admin Dashboard with heading 'اتجاهات الكمبوندات (6 أشهر)', all four metric-switcher testids present and switchable, 4 legend buttons (one per compound) that hide/show lines (opacity 1↔0.4, SVG paths 96↔94). 'مقارنة الكمبوندات' (compounds-comparison-view) renders above the trend chart as required.

minor.issue: App-owner (Owner_homeme) token returns 400 'company_id query param مطلوب' instead of 403. Spec said 'reject non-company-admin with 403'. By design owner has cross-company access — this is RBAC-correct but doc says 403. Recommend clarifying spec OR returning 403 to non-company-admin tokens unless company_id provided.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid='theme-toggle'. Identifiable only via aria-label='Switch to dark mode'/'Switch to light mode' (which changes on toggle, making stable selectors fragile). Add data-testid for reliable automation.

action_items: Add data-testid="theme-toggle" to /app/frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.js for stable test selectors.

Clarify or align the /api/company-admin/compounds-trend RBAC contract: spec says 'reject non-company-admin with 403' but app_owner currently gets 400 (company_id missing). Either return 403 unless ?company_id= is provided, or update spec docs.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend trend endpoint correctly enforces 6 entries per compound and cumulative residents (verified non-decreasing across 6 months for all 4 compounds of testcompany2).

Double-sided referral: registering with referral_code=CO-XXXX creates a WELCOME- coupon (15% percentage, max_uses=1, applicable_plans=[], reward_for_user set) AND a referral_welcome notification containing both '15%' and the coupon code. Registering without referral_code creates neither — clean conditional.
Synthetic @homeme.qa emails bypass SMTP welcome send (per spec) — pytest is fast and side-effect free.

ThemeToggle UX: aria-label updates dynamically (Switch to dark ↔ Switch to light) — accessible but the lack of data-testid is the only testability gap. Body background switches rgb(255,255,255) ↔ rgb(11,18,32) on toggle, html.dark class toggles, localStorage.darkMode persists ('true'/'false') and survives reload.
Compounds Trend Chart legend uses opacity (1 → 0.4) plus SVG path removal to indicate hidden state — works for sighted users; consider also adding aria-pressed for screen readers.
